meta_description:
143 likes, 15 comments - kateodonnell.ayurveda on August 23, 2026: "@Nidhisunil told me something I keep returning to: after years of constant output, the first thing that helped her sleep again wasn't a prescription. It was dal, rice, and ghee — a bowl of kitchari her body remembered from growing up in Kerala.

In an increasingly successful modeling career, she'd been running on adrenaline through red-eye flights to Paris and back, until burnout stopped her completely. Insomnia. Panic. Total depletion. What brought her back was food, rest, and eventually a whole new relationship with her own worth.
This one is for anyone who's been extracting from themselves for too long, or anyone who is looking to reframe “self worth.”

And a shout out to this season’s sponsors @drtungs, @banyanbotanicals, and @banyanfarmlife for helping us get important information like this out there!

Listen to the pod Everyday Ayurveda with Kate wherever you get your podcasts. Please subscribe, review, and help me keep producing these.

#AyurvedaPodcast #AyurvedaCommunity #Burnout #SelfCare #Transition".
